test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statement.

**Statements:**

Some woods are charcoals

Some petrol is diesel

All diesel are fossils

**Conclusions :**

(I) Some petrol are charcoals

(II) Some fossils are petrol

(III) Some woods are diesel

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows

solution:
Statements:

Some woods are charcoals

Some petrol is diesel

All diesel are fossils

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/922802e9d25b66c82d5ffeb6b1f3669e4e563d5eb84251803535f03efb42c636.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ea0079477910f31a37d73a1119a314736e24806df719ba77c8d6dca39104332.png] 

Conclusions :

(I) Some petrol are charcoals → False (No direct relationship is given between petrol and charcoals, so it may be possible but not defined)

(II) Some fossils are petrol → **True** (Some petrol is diesal and all diesal are fossils, so some fossils are petrol)

(III) Some woods are diesel → False (No direct relationship is given between woods and diesel, so it may be possible but not defined)

Hence, **'Only conclusion II follows'**.
